items.why: Mark Zuckerberg unveiled the Muse Wonder frontier AI model, and strong Muse app engagement data plus new AI glasses hardware from Meta Connect fed AI optimism ahead of the Oct 27 earnings.
Profit-taking after record highs: the stock broke $620 support, ARK sold about $15.8M of shares, and chipmakers sold off broadly on AI spending and memory-chip competition worries.
Crude rallied after deadly attacks on Saudi airports lifted supply-risk fears, carrying energy producers and oil majors higher.
Volatility edged up as chipmakers slid and crude surged, keeping the broader tape little changed in a choppy session.

market_note: Dow futures outperformed, up 0.3%, while Nasdaq futures lagged, down 0.75%, on chip sector weakness.
summary: Stocks were mixed Monday afternoon: tech and chipmakers sagged on profit-taking while energy rallied with crude, leaving the S&P about flat.
